notes.title: Elevated Content Updated Released - 31/10/21
notes.content:
Jump into Elevated's next two maps, Hexes and Dark Shaft! 
Fight high in the sky on Hexes, a faster paced, more difficult map. Enemies spawn faster and can rise from anywhere. All platforms fall, and you have no guarantee of sure footing. Rise through the ranks to claim first place on the leaderboard, and unlock new starting weapons as you progress!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40174806/bdc64f426e6c3a9811c82e496fcabdfd03696f90.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40174806/b22e09f0a8e831dcc8c56bd925dd48515d2e4026.png

The second new map, Dark Shaft, is a reimagining and improvement on Elevated's first map, Lit Shaft. The power may have been shut off from the lights, but the robots are still running! Manage keeping the lights on so you can stand a chance against the hordes of enemies coming after you! Like Hexes, Dark Shaft also includes new starting weapons to unlock that may give you an edge in the darkness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40174806/5c5c895768818698cc5395956f8f96bfa014c3c9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40174806/8374bb1575f2c7a3aafc5fb304bc1b5aa86f8816.png

Along with these two new maps comes a slew of much needed QoL improvements!

Controls Popup: On your first attempt after selecting a map a much needed controls screen will now appear! The number of players who never realised you could dodge roll with Space really hammered the need for this one home.
Powerup Timers: Now after collecting a powerup, an onscreen timer will appear on the left of the screen informing you of its remaining duration!


Balance Changes + Bug fixes:

Increased duration of all powerups from 15 seconds to 20.
Reduced Dogbot enemy rocket turn rate from 0.03 to 0.025.



Fixed Spike Drone flying off maps that do not have 4 walls.
Fixed Sniper Rifles laser sight lock on bug on maps that do not have 4 walls.
Fixed Fireball weapon's orbiting projectiles not staying at the same height as the player.

notes.title: Elevated Map Content Updated Released!
notes.content:
Take a fall into Elevated's second map, Conveyor!! Fight your opponents as they are constructed around you, on constantly moving conveyors between dangerous laser beams - how high will you score?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40174806/acd9af60df3edc294a433655fdcc9c4ea6fa3d14.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40174806/91fbbc134cd794735b3b2bf2a204997ba467bc48.jpg

Along with the new map come two new powerups!

Fire Projectiles: Your bullets will set enemies on fire for the duration, as well as create fire on the ground where they hit. Standing in the fire deals damage to both you and the enemies.
Movement Speed: Your movement speed is increased greatly, allowing you to dodge enemies and projectiles much easier. Your dodge speed and recharge rate are also greatly increased!


A full list of changes, including balance changes and quality of life updates are listed below.

Balance Changes:

Pulse armour: Damage increased from 10 to 12. Knockback increased from 500 to 1000.
Assault Rifle: Bullet spread reduced from 5 to 3.5
Tornado Cannon: Tornado movement speed increased from 3 to 4. Tornado secondary projectile AOE increased from 3 to 3.5.
Raygun: Damage increased from 1.5 to 3.5. Fire rate reduced from 0.07 to 0.1. Electric powerup pulse damage from 8 to 2.5.
Minigun: Damage increased from 2 to 3. Starting bullet spread reduced from 5 to 2. Max bullet spread from 18 - 12. Projectile duration increased to reach opposite sides of the map.
Turrets: Fire rate improved from 1 to 0.4. Reload speed increased from 3 to 2.9. Turret damage increased from 5 to 8.
Pulse Grenade: Fire rate improved from 2 to 1. Pulse AOE increased from 1.5 to 2.
Beehive Launcher: Bees created from final explosion reduced from 36 to 26.
Button Damage Powerup: Damage increased from 10 to 15.
Nailgun: Projectile duration increased from 0.2 to 0.25.
SMG: Projectile duration increased from 0.6 to 0.7.
Pistol: Projectile duration increased from 0.8 to 1.4. Projectile speed increased from 20 to 22.
Rainbow Rifle: Fire rate improved from 0.4 to 0.36.


Quality of Life + bug fixes:

Increased range of collecting weapons by 10%.
Reduced Player Turret fire SFX volume.
Reduced Electric Hit SFX volume.
Fixed bug where the buzzsaw projectile did not despawn if a weapon swap occurred while out.
Improved optimisation of electric particles effects.
Increased size of play button on level select for readability.
